title: Receipt photo, place, VAT and monthly expenses
problem: Expenses had no receipt, no branch, no VAT and rent or internet had to be typed again every month.
now: Record expense takes a receipt photo, the place, VAT on the bill and Repeat every month; repeating ones are listed with Stop.
steps: Pick Rent, add a photo, a place and VAT
Tick Repeat every month and save
See it under Repeats monthly and press Stop
notes: Where: Finances › Income & expenses › Record expense (/expenses-bills)

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
